title: Exact Design Game for Sample Average Treatment Effect Inference under Local Privacy
banked_reason: The promised optimizer-attaining equality cell and actual phase boundary were not established; the exact unrestricted lower certificate remained 297/50000000 below the feasible upper value, leaving only an incremental reduction, balance ray, and nonbinary exclusion result.
gap_reasons: The promised equality-cell and actual phase-boundary result is replaced by a conditional certificate schema and a nonbinary exclusion interval; no attaining Gamma_J, nonempty equality cell, or frontier is supplied.

The unrestricted optimum at lambda=1000 is only bracketed within 5.94e-6, so no minimizing channel is identified, while the certificate-characterization theorem is conditional on precisely the optimizer-attaining global certificate that is not supplied.
The named rational tables and four checkers are absent from both core.json dependencies and the run directory, so the headline numerical results are not reproducible.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the finite orbit/Blackwell reduction, fixed-channel LP formulation, polynomial attainment, an N=4 balance ray, and a narrow nonbinary exclusion interval. A dedicated construct-and-determine round could not turn the conditional certificate schema into an optimizer-attaining balanced-binary cell or actual boundary: the exact global lower certificate remained 297/50000000 below the feasible upper value. The sound remainder is incremental, while reproducibility and one LP citation claim also remain incomplete as recorded above.
tldr: Exact finite-population SATE inference under local privacy reduces to a fourteen-pattern, degree-\(N\) polynomial channel game with an inner exact confidence linear program. At \(N=4\), \(\alpha=2/5\), and \(\lambda=1000\), rational certificates bracket the unrestricted optimum within \(5.94\times10^{-6}\), while revealed-input dominance and monotone privacy feasibility force balanced allocation for every \(\lambda\ge1000\). Four-ary response strictly beats every balanced binary-partition response throughout \([999.9,1000.1]\). No optimizer-attaining balanced-binary cell or actual equality-set boundary is established.
gap: Existing causal local-privacy theory optimizes population estimation risk or asymptotic confidence width, exact randomization inference fixes a nonprivate observation experiment, and staircase optimality applies to convex single-draw utilities. Their intersection leaves the exact common-channel SATE confidence game and its design boundaries unresolved.
fill: The project supplies a lossless orbit and channel reduction, exact primal--dual confidence inference, an attained polynomial formulation, certified nonbinary evidence, and an algebraic continuation method culminating in one sign-certified balanced-binary phase boundary.
